whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Infinity Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.4★ reviews from nearly 1,000 customers at Biscomaun Bhawan in Gandhi Maidan, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, aur panoramic view highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/infinity

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Infinity Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Infinity Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! Humne ise specifically aapke Biscomaun Bhawan, Gandhi Maidan location ke liye design kiya hai—jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, high-res menu showcase, aur stunning rooftop/panoramic view vibes highlight kiye hain. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
